gaps.sentence: The national anthem ___ (compose) by a little-known music teacher.
gaps.explanation: Past simple passive: was + composed; 'by a music teacher' names the agent.

gaps.sentence: Her memoir ___ (translate) into fourteen languages so far.
gaps.explanation: 'So far' requires present perfect passive: has been + translated (singular 'memoir').

gaps.sentence: English ___ (speak) as a first language in more than fifty countries.
gaps.explanation: Present simple passive: is + spoken. Facts about the language, not about a speaker.

gaps.sentence: My usual barber's chair ___ (fix), so I'm trying a new salon.
gaps.explanation: Present continuous passive: is being + fixed for an unfinished, ongoing repair.

gaps.sentence: The escaped prisoner ___ (believe) to be hiding in the mountains.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal passive pattern: subject + is believed/said/reported + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: They're getting the garden ___ (landscape) this spring.
gaps.explanation: Causative with get: are getting + the garden + landscaped.

gaps.sentence: A new ring road ___ (construct) around the city at present.
gaps.explanation: 'At present' requires present continuous passive: is being + constructed.

gaps.sentence: The whole street ___ when the gas main burst.
gaps.explanation: The street was evacuated by others: past necessity had to be + evacuated.
